changelog: FIX: Firestick D-pad confirm now reliably bridges from Movies and Series category rail into the content grid instead of bouncing focus away.
FIX: Movies and Series loading now uses strict timeouts and off-main-thread filtering to prevent long hangs and random exits to home.
FIX: Guide loading and EPG fallback processing are bounded and moved off the UI thread to improve stability on large playlists.
FIX: OTA updater now validates both expected file size and SHA256 before install, with explicit on-screen error messaging.
FIX: OTA completion handling now has receiver plus polling fail-safe so updates do not get stuck at 100% after download.
FIX: Settings account editor now dismisses the keyboard on password done/save for smoother remote-only flow.
